# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 36

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 036
**Total Disagreements:** 2

---

## Disagreement 1 — "do not worry" vs. "stop worrying"

**Verse:** v.1
**EMET/LOGOS:** "do not worry"
**PNEUMA:** "stop worrying"
**Issue:** PNEUMA's "stop" implies the worrying is currently happening; "do not" is a general prohibition. Both are defensible but "do not worry" is more literal.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Do not worry" retained.

---

## Disagreement 2 — Coptic vs. P.Oxy 655 scope

**All agents:** Note the P.Oxy version is much longer
**Issue:** Should the P.Oxy addition (food, lilies) be included in notes?
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** Noted in consensus; Coptic-only text translated without P.Oxy expansion.

---
